wages.text: Lee supports raising the federal minimum wage and expanding union rights.
wages.quote: Raise the federal minimum wage to a living wage

debt.text: Lee supports cutting wasteful spending while protecting Social Security, Medicare, Medicaid and core services.
debt.quote: Cutting wasteful spending and protecting Social Security, Medicare, Medicaid and core services working families rely on.

immigration.text: Lee advocates for immigration reform that creates a pathway to citizenship for Dreamers.
immigration.quote: securing the border while creating a pathway to citizenship for Dreamers.

guns.text: Lee supports requiring a background check for every gun sale.
guns.quote: Ensure every gun sale includes a background check

abortion.text: Lee supports ensuring emergency reproductive care for women facing pregnancy complications as part of her plan to restore nationwide abortion access.
abortion.quote: Ensure that women facing pregnancy complications get the emergency care they need

health.text: Lee supports Medicare for All and expanding Medicare coverage to include vision, dental, hearing, and mental health services.
health.quote: she will fight for Medicare for All, as well as expanding Medicare to include mental health, dental, vision, and hearing coverage.

voting.text: Lee supports early voting and voting by mail and opposes voter-ID laws intended to suppress turnout.
voting.quote: Support early voting and vote-by-mail (which Arizona already does well!)

tax.text: Lamb's campaign says he supports lower taxes and a smaller federal government.
tax.quote: His campaign continues to focus on border security, constitutional rights, lower taxes, and reducing the size of government.

debt.text: Lamb warns that federal overspending and debt shift financial burdens to future generations and calls for fiscal responsibility.
debt.quote: continued federal overspending threatens future generations

schools.text: Lamb supports federal tax credits or scholarships for private, home and online schooling.
schools.quote: Education money should follow the child. Parents know their kids better than any federal agency does and parental authority should not be usurped or abridged in any way.

safety.text: Lamb says he supports law enforcement and opposes defunding police.

immigration.text: Lamb supports ICE, stronger immigration enforcement and action against criminal networks.
immigration.quote: ICE has an important role in immigration enforcement and criminal investigations. I believe eliminating the agency would weaken our ability to enforce immigration law and confront the criminal networks that exploit our country.

guns.text: Lamb describes himself as a strong supporter of gun rights and Arizona's Stand Your Ground laws.
guns.quote: Nobody is a stronger supporter of Arizona’s Stand Your Ground laws, the 2nd Amendment and our God-given Constitutional rights than me.

abortion.text: Lamb says life begins at conception and opposes taxpayer funding for abortion providers.
abortion.quote: I am unapologetically a believer that life begins at conception. Not one taxpayer dollar should reach the abortion industry, directly or through any pass-through.

gender.toward: rules based on sex at birth
gender.text: Lamb supports federal legislation reserving women's sports for biological females.
gender.quote: I believe women's sports should be protected for biological females, and I will support federal legislation that permanently preserves fairness and opportunity for female athletes.

energy.text: Lamb advocates expanding domestic energy production and reducing regulations that raise energy costs.
energy.quote: He advocated for expanding domestic energy production and reducing regulations that increase costs for American families.

voting.text: Lamb supports voter-identification requirements and other election-administration changes intended to increase confidence.
voting.quote: Election integrity remains one of his highest priorities. Lamb supports voter identification requirements and reforms designed to improve confidence in Arizona elections.
